items.name: theme
items.title: Ninaero theme
items.description: Shared light and dark tokens with Ninaero squircle Button styling.

.ninaero-button.transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, transform 80ms ease-out

.ninaero-button--secondary.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--button-paper-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--button-paper-shade), 0 2px 0 var(--button-shadow), 0 3px 6px var(--button-shadow)

.ninaero-button--destructive.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--button-destructive-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--button-destructive-shade), 0 2px 0 var(--button-destructive-shadow), 0 3px 6px var(--button-destructive-shadow)
